usage: CodeScene PR quality gates for bro — the ladder, expressed as code. Rules are tried in order and the FIRST match wins; no match means no gates. Rung 3 (pay_down_tech_debt) = files with zero CodeScene findings — the strictest bar, goal enforcement included. Rung 2 (bare_minimum) = files with advisory findings only — the critical-rule safety net. Rung 1 (floor) = the legacy backlog — 'no new technical debt' only, pre-existing debt tolerated. Each wave cleans a batch of files and promotes them one rung; the rungs are ordered strictest-first so a promotion only ever takes effect for the files it names. Generated from a cs CLI scan (cs review --output-format json).
